attchmntText: Aqylon Nexus Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for the Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Aqylon Nexus Limited published its standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of 364.20 lakhs, compared to a loss of 132.98 lakhs in the same period last year. Revenue from operations stood at 825.00 lakhs. The board reviewed the results on 14th November 2026. The company recorded an exceptional loss of 188.52 lakhs due to the write-off of immovable property mortgaged to Punjab National Bank. Basic and diluted earnings per share were 0.14. The results were published in the Financial Express and Pratahkal newspapers.

attchmntText: Aqylon Nexus Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Aqylon Nexus Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, based on the Audit Committee's recommendation. The meeting commenced at 15:20 P.M. and concluded at 16:00 P.M. An independent auditor's review report was received from Bilimoria Mehta & Co., Chartered Accountants. The auditors stated that nothing came to their attention to suggest material misstatements in the financial results prepared under Indian Accounting Standard 34. The company submitted the limited review report and the financial results to the stock exchanges for record. Parth R. Rupareliya, Managing Director with DIN 10703133, signed the communication.
